Commentary.Commentary: With 384 on the board, South Africa would be more pumped up in the dressing room. Sri Lanka chasing it seems unlikely. Join us in a bit for the chase.

Things seemed to change in the final 10 overs as Amla started to accelerate. Such was his might that he hit 16 off 3 consecutive deliveries off Gunaratne. Behardien too played a handy knock of 32 at a strike rate of 160. As far Sri Lanka are concerned, except Vandersay, everyone went for runs and looked sub par. The fielding too didn't help as they dropped a number of catches.

After de Kock's wicket it was time for 4th ODI centurion Faf du Plessis to take the attack to the bowlers as he scored a breezy knock of 41 off 34 balls. But after Madushanka had him removed, the run rate fell a bit as Amla struggled to find boundaries regularly.

South Africa couldn't have asked for a better start after being asked to bat first. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla began extremely well scoring 71 off the initial 10 overs. The partnership blossomed more along the way, thanks to some poor bowling, as they put together a 187-run stand. It was de Kock who powered through during the partnership, scoring his 12th ODI ton in the process.
Bowls a high full toss outside off, Morris hits it over covers for a run. SOUTH AFRICA END UP WITH A MAMMOTH TOTAL OF 384/6.
Comes around the wicket and hurls it in the line of the stumps, Parnell comes down the track and drives it to long on. Single taken!
Gets it right this time and bowls it well outside off, Morris runs it down to third man for a single.
Wide! His idea is right but falters with his execution a touch. Gets it a bit wider of the tramline outside off as Morris fails to reach it.
On a full length and well outside off, Morris plays it with an open face to the man at point.
Wide! Hurls in another full delivery wide outside off, Chris lets it go.
Wayne Parnell is the new man in.

OUT! A good cameo of 32 from 20 from Behardien comes to an end! Sees Farhaan shuffling a long way across and bowls a full toss near the wide tramline. Farhaan kneels and hits it right down the throat of Gunaratne at long on. He bends and takes a good catch with his fingers pointing upwards.

Dropped! Behardien shuffles a long way across and lofts it nicely towards widish long off. Weerakkody runs a bit to his left, crouches low to take the catch but the ball pops out of his hands. Two runs taken!
Wide! Slower one way outside off, Behardien has nothing to do with it.
Bowls a full length ball outside off, Behardien makes room and carves it to sweeper cover. A wicket and 9 runs from that over!
Smart change of pace once again as Madushanka bowls a shortish delivery on off, Behardien miscues his pull to the mid-wicket region and the ball falls in no man's land. Two runs taken!
Slower one around off, Morris plays it to long on and takes a run.
Farhaan comes down the track to the full length delivery in the line of the stumps and drills it to long off. Single taken!
Chris Morris replaces Hashim Amla at the centre.

OUT! A great knock from Amla comes to an end! He played with poise and grace but also with power. Bowls a short of a length ball outside off, Hashim punches it off his back foot with good power over point but is unfortunate to pick out the man positioned at the fence. Kusal Mendis is composed out there and takes a good catch.
FOUR! Well played! Amla makes room to the back of the length ball outside off and places it uppishly behind Pathirana at point. There is no one in the deep and the ball races to the fence.
Good presence of mind from Lakmal! Follows Behariden outside off again and he fails to connect with his flay shot.
Good call by the umpire to not call it a wide! Sees Behardien shuffling across a long way and hurls it very wide outside off, Farhaan tries to reach it but fails to make any connection.
Slips a full toss outside off, Behardien plays it down to third man and gets a couple for it.
SIX! Behardien on the charge! Bowls a full toss on leg stump, Farhaan stays rooted to the crease and smacks it over deep mid-wicket to clear the fence with ease.
Hashim Amla brings up his 4th ODI score of 150 or more.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Slips in a full toss, Farhaan plays it to the leg side and brings back Amla on strike.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, Behardien drills it to long on. Single taken! 16 runs off the over.
Full length ball outside off, Amla drives it through covers for a single.

SIX! Length delivery on off, shaping in. Amla lunges forward and hits it straight down the ground. Perhaps has got it a little high on the bat but still has enough on it to go over the fence. That shot brings up the 350-run mark.

SIX! Amla is showing that he not only relies on timing but has the big shots up his sleeve! Gets underneath the fuller length ball in the line of the stumps and smokes it over long on for a gorgeous maximum.
Fullish delivery on off, drilled down to long on for a run.
Full delivery outside off, Amla drives it through mid off and takes a single.
SIX! Take that, Kumara! Behardien takes full toll of the fuller length ball and slogs it over widish mid on. Hit that with sheer power and the ball sails into the stands. 16 runs from that over!
Slips in a full toss on middle, Amla has a heave across the line but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls to the right side of the keeper and Amla takes a single.
Fullish and straying on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball in the line of the stumps, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! He does it for the second time and with sheer finesse! Hurls in a full delivery wide outside off, Hashim reaches out and carves it with an open face over point. Gets good elevation and the ball clears the fence easily.
On a length around off, Farhaan works it through mid-wicket and gets a run for it.
Lahiru Kumara introduced back into the attack.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball shaping in. Farhaan cuts this one to the man at point.
Amla shuffles across to the fullish delivery outside off and whips it to deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Slower one around off, driven towards mid on for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.

SIX! That's an amazing shot! Amla is reigning supreme here. Bowls a full length ball outside off, Amla makes room and carves it over point to perfection. Has struck that beautifully and the ball hits the boundary ropes on full.
Lahiru Madushanka comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Shot! Short of a length and width on offer, Behardien cashes on and thrashes it through covers for a superb boundary.
Full length ball outside off, Amla goes across his sticks and looks to scoop it initially but has to readjust. Plays it behind point for a run.
Bowls a full toss, Behardien eases it to long on to get off the mark.
Farhaan Behardien arrives at the crease.

OUT! Lakmal gets his second wicket! Perhaps, JP Duminy is a bit unlucky there. Drops a short delivery around middle and leg, Duminy looks to pull it but misses and is struck on the thigh pad. The ball lobs onto the back of his bat, strikes it and spoons towards Dickwella behind the stumps. He pouches it safely and Duminy makes the long walk back.
FOUR! On a length angling in, Duminy skips down the track and clips it through mid-wicket for a neat boundary.
Two Leg byes! Comes around the wicket and slips it down the leg side, Duminy looks to pull it but misses and the ball kisses his pads and rolls to the legs side. Two leg byes taken!
Leg bye! The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one. They pick up a single. Leg byes given by the umpire. 18 runs off the over!
Length delivery a bit wider this time, Hashim makes room and lofts it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Power this time and he has connected that amazingly well! Back of a length ball, spinning in. Amla waits for it and pulls it over square leg and the ball sails into the stands.
FOUR! Well played, Hashim! Fuller length ball and width on offer, Amla slices it over backward point and the ball rockets to the fence. He is playing with sheer authority!
FOUR! Terrific shot! Slow and fullish delivery on middle, Amla clears his front leg and goes downtown. Has hit that off the meat of the bat and earns a boundary to his name.
Wide! Asela gets his radar wrong and slips it way outside off stump. Amla has nothing to do with it.
Shortish delivery cutting in, JP half-pulls it through square leg and takes a single.
Asela Gunaratne comes back into the attack.
Fuller length ball coming in with the angle, Duminy heaves it over square leg and takes a single to retain the strike.
Well bowled! Goes wider of the crease and bowls a good yorker on middle and leg, Amla digs it out down the wicket and takes a single.

Leg bye! Comes around the wicket to the southpaw again and hurls in a full length ball in the line of the stumps. JP looks to clip it across but is rapped on the front pad. The ball rolls to the leg side and they take a leg bye.
Change of bat for JP Duminy.
Back of a length on off, Amla shuffles across and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Intelligent bowling by Lakmal! Sees Duminy coming down the track and bowls it right in the blockhole. Duminy digs it out through covers and gets a single to his name.
Short of a length ball outside off, Amla looks to pull it but mistimes it towards mid on. Single taken!
Suranga Lakmal comes back into the attack.
Amla flicks this to the on side to retain strike. One run added to the total!
On a length, outside off, Duminy punches this to covers and runs one.
24th ODI Century for Hashim Amla
Length ball, outside off, Amla pushes it through point and runs a single. Gets to the milestone with that shot. Tremendous effort this from HA, however his job now would be to accelerate quickly.
Slower ball, Duminy guides it towards third man for a single.
Duminy looks to steer it down to third man but instead inside edges it towards keeper.
Short of a length delivery, Amla dabs it to third man and runs one.
Power play three has been signalled. Now maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Amla eases it to long off for a single.
Looks to cut but misses.
Amla drives this straight to covers.
Tossed up, outside off, Duminy pushes it towards covers and runs one.
Amla drives this through covers for a single.
Jean-Paul Duminy is the new man in.

OUT! BIG WICKET THIS! Tossed up, outside off, de Villiers looks to drive it over the covers, gets the connection but couldn't get the distance. Kumara runs to his right from sweeper cover to catch it with both hands. A very crucial breakthrough at this stage as de Villiers can be really dangerous in the last 10 overs.
ABD under-edges this fuller ball through leg side to pick up a single.
FOUR! The cheekiness has begun. Full delivery, ABD gets down and plays the reverse sweep beating the short third man quite comfortably.
Slower one, back of a length, around, Amla works this around through mid-wicket and runs a single.
On a length, de Villiers tucks this through the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Length ball, around off, ABD uses his feet and lofts it over mid off to score his first boundary of the innings. Expect more of these now.
Length delivery, ABD looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
ABD flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Poor, poor delivery. Bowls this down the leg side. ABD kneels and looks to sweep it but misses as the ball goes past the keeper for five extras.
Amla cuts this to point and runs one.
Tosses this one outside off, Amla shoulders his arms.
Amla drives this straight to covers.
Short and wide, ABD punches it through covers and runs one.
Sprays this on leg, AB paddle sweeps it fine to get off the mark with a brace.
Meanwhile, Jeffrey Vandersay comes back for a bowl.
AB de Villiers walks out to bat.

OUT! Sri Lanka finally get some respite. Nothing was going their way. The slower one, rather off cutter does the trick for Madushanka. Pitched on length, outside off, Faf looks to whack it over long off but top edges it in the end. But Lakmal runs to his left from mid off and takes an easy catch. Should the Sri Lankans be happy though? Because this wicket has brought ABD into the crease.
On a length, on middle, du Plessis punches through mid-wicket and runs one.
On a length, on middle, du Plessis punches through mid-wicket and runs one.
Slower one, outside off, Amla gets low and drives through covers for a single.
Short of a length delivery, outside off, Amla gets under it but cuts this straight to the cover-point fielder.
Length delivery, around middle, Faf pushes it through mid on and runs one.
Lahiru Madushanka comes back for a bowl.
FOUR! Looks to flight but Amla dances down the track and slams it towards deep mid-wicket to enter the nervous 90s.
Tossed up delivery, Amla works it around to the mid-wicket fielder.
Amla cuts it straight to cover point fielder.
Sprays this around middle, Faf drives it to long on for a single.
Flights this delivery, around middle, Amla knocks it through mid off and runs one.
Looped delivery, around off, Faf eases it down to long off for a single.
Amla drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Faf goes back and punches it towards mid-wicket to run a single.
Sprays this one outside off, Amla drives to deep cover and runs one.
50-run stand up for Amla and du Plessis in 48 deliveries.
Floated delivery, around off, Faf pushes it towards sweeper cover to bring up the milestone with a single.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, Amla punches it off the back foot through covers. One run added to the total!
Shorter and flatter, Faf pulls it to wide of long on and runs one.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes back into the attack.
Shortish delivery, Faf cuts it to deep point for an easy single.
Faf drives it straight to covers.
SIX! Think Faf has a score in mind, it certainly feels like if you see the way he's batting. Floated delivery, outside off, du Plessis whacks it over extra cover for a maximum.
Amla drives this to covers. One run added to the total!
Flighted delivery, around middle, Faf works it around through mid-wicket to take a single.
Tosses this one outside off, Amla drives it to sweeper cover and runs one.
Time for Drinks.
Short delivery, Amla pulls it to fine leg to retain strike. 18 runs off the over. However, more than the runs, it is the drop that will concern the Sri Lankans.

FOUR! Destruction mode activated! Length delivery, on leg, Amla gets across and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. This over has somewhat set the momentum for South Africa. Their aim will be to build on it.

DROPPED! Slower delivery on middle, Faf looks to loft it over mid on, but doesn't connect well at all. Pathirana runs across to grab it, even gets his hands to it but in the end fluffs it. Huge opportunity missed. They rotate strike!
SIX! Full toss, around middle, Faf gets down and paddle sweeps it behind the keeper which goes for a maximum. Modern bats, I tell you!
Good length delivery, outside off, Faf pushes slowly through covers. Oh good runing there, urges Amla to come for the second and completes it easily. Two runs taken!
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, outside off, Faf hammers this to deep mid-wicket. Supreme shot, the deep square leg had no chance. Tharanga has a talk with Kumara after that pull.
Amla looks to push it through covers but mistimes as the ball falls back on the pitch. Maiden over! Who thought one would bowl this in the match?
Looped up, Amla drives it the cover-point fielder.
Tosses this one around off, Amla punches it towards covers.
Amla drives it to covers.
Flight on offer, which invariably turns into the full toss, Amla sweeps it to short fine leg.
Tossed  up delivery, on middle, Amla knocks it down the ground.
Du plessis comes down the track and looks to heave the back of the length delivery over long on but ends up mistiming it towards mid on. Only two runs off this over, well bowled Kumara!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Oh! Where did that come from? Bowls a waist high full toss around his rib cage area. Faf fends it off through square leg. Amla was backing up and the fielder lobs a throw over his head. Dhananjaya who was beside the stumps gets a bad bounce as he makes a half-stop.

Bowls a very fullish delivery on the stumps, Faf digs it out towards Kumara. He collects it on his follow through and hurls in a direct hit at the striker's end. Du Plessis was down the pitch but manages to get back in time.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Fullish delivery around off, du Plessis makes room and drives it through covers. Lakmal gives a chase from mid off and puts in a slide near the boundary. Mendis is aware of the situation, sprints across and collects the throw from Lakmal and returns a good throw. Keeps it down to two.
Lahiru Kumara comes back into the attack.
Loopy ball on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, Amla drives it nicely to long off. A run taken!
Fuller length ball on off, Amla clears his front leg and pushes it to extra cover.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Tossed up on ball middle and leg, Amla camps back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Sachith Pathirana comes back for a bowl.
Fullish ball shaping in on middle, Amla works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fuller length ball angling in, Amla eases it towards the man at mid on and takes a brisk single.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Amla gets behind the line and digs it back to the bowler.
Camps back to the length delivery and defends it calmly.
On a length outside off, du Plessis drives it through covers and gets a run for it.

Faf has been hit on his shin as he was running to the non-striker's end. Upul Tharanga asked him whether he was fine, Faf gives him a thumbs up. South AFrcia's No 3 seems to be in some pain but he's not opting for medical attention.

Tossed up outside off, du Plessis drives it to the man at mid on and takes him on. He is haring across and the fielder's shy misses the stumps and hits Faf on the shin. He seems to be in pain, hope he is alright.
In the air... but safe! Slow through the air around off, spinning in. Amla has a wild swipe across the line but gets an outside edge towards point. Single taken!
Shorter outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman guides it to third man. Two runs added to the total.
Drags his length back outside off, pushed off the back foot to the off side. Single taken!
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis eases it through covers for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Similar length ball outside off, Faf plays it with soft hands to the man at point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf looks to place it through the off side but is cramped up a bit. Only manages to defend it down the track.
Wide! Bangs in a short delivery outside off, du Plessis is not bothered to play at that one. Wide signalled by the umpire for height!
Faf du Plessis comes out to bat at the centre.

OUT! The bowling change works! Intelligent bowling by Lakmal! Bowls a shortish delivery and rolls his fingers over it. It's cutting across de Kock who looks to make room for himself and looks to slash it finer but isn't able to hit it in the region where he intended. Ends up playing it in the air towards sweeper cover. Weerakkody runs to his right, judges it nicely and takes a good low catch. De Kock departs after a brilliant knock of 109  from 87 balls and the mammoth opening-stand of 187 is broken.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Amla guides it towards the gully region. The fielder from point comes across to cut it off. Single taken!
Slower and shortish delivery at 121.8 clicks in the line of the stumps, de Kock pulls it through square leg and gets a single to his name.
Suranga Lakmal comes back into the attack.
Drags his length back outside off again, punched off the back foot through covers. Single taken!
Short delivery outside off, spinning away. Amla punches it to sweeper cover for a single,
Tossed up delivery, de Kock reverse sweeps it towards backward point. The fielder there misfields and concedes the single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Lands it outside off, Amla camps back and cuts it to the man at short third man.
Tossed up around off, clipped nicely against the spin to deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Length ball, de Kock eases it to long off and runs a single.
FOUR! Similar delivery, same treatment. This time however, he sweeps it more fine to get the desired result.
12th ODI Century for Quinton de Kock.

FOUR! Length ball, on leg, de Kock kneels and sweeps it magnificently towards backward square leg. The deep mid-wicket fielder gave it a chase only to come second. Brings up the milestone with it. Top knock this, he's cruising along.
Full delivery, on middle, de Kock knocks it back to the bowler.
On a length, nipping back in, Amla goes back and flicks it through mid-wicket to bring QDK back on strike. One run added to the total!
Length ball, around leg, de Kock flicks it to deep square leg and runs one. He's batting on 96!
FOUR! He is flowing at the moment! Drags his length back outside off, turning away. Amla rocks back and cuts it beautifully behind point and the ball races to the fence.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Amla leaves it alone.
Amla comes down the track to the length delivery but has to readjust at the last moment as he defends it.
FOUR! Great shot! Tossed up outside off, Amla lunges forward and drills it past extra cover. Hit that really well and gets a boundary to his name.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a fullish ball on the stumps, de Kock clips it to the on side and gets a run for it. Moves to 95 from 77 balls!
Tossed up around off, Amla comes down the track and works it to the leg side for a single.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Amla works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length in the line of the stumps, Amla strides forward and defends it nicely down the track.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Well played! Length delivery on middle and leg, cutting across Quinton. He waits for it nicely and cuts it through point and the ball races to the fence. He is looking supremely confident out there.
On a length, cutting in. Amla clips it to deep mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, de Kock looks to loft it inside out initially but only manages to slice it uppishly to deep cover. Single taken!
Quicker one outside off, Quinton drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single. 150 up for South Africa!
Tossed up on the stumps, de Kock clips it round the corner and gets a run.
FOUR! Tossed up outside leg stump, de Kock manages to get a fine tickle on it and beats the keeper and runs down to the fine leg fence.
Tossed up around off, driven to mid off.
Amla comes down the track to the tossed up delivery outside off and knocks it to long on. Single taken!
On a length on middle and leg, Amla clips it round the corner for a single and retains the strike.
On a length on middle and leg, Quinton plays it to the on side for a run.
On a length, cutting across Quinton. He camps back and cuts it nicely through cover-point. Gets two runs for doing so.
Slower one outside leg stump, cutting in. de Kock sweeps it but picks out the man at short fine leg.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, de Kock defends it towards mid off.
Off-cutter outside off, de Kock cuts it to the man at backward point.
On middle and leg, worked with the spin round the corner. Single taken!
Flighted outside off, Amla eases it to sweeper cover. Single taken!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, swept hard to deep square leg for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Amla drives it through covers for a single.
Shorter length ball outside off, de Kock cuts it to sweeper cover and the good running between the two allows them to come back for the second.
Straying on the hips this time, worked with ease through square leg for a single.
Slow delivery on the stumps, Quinton sweeps it uppishly to deep mid-wicket. The fielder stationed at the boundary covers good ground to his left and keeps it down to a run.
On a length outside off, cutting in again. Amla gets behind the line and eases it to long on for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, cutting in. Amla works it to the man at short mid-wicket.
On a length in the line of the stumps, de Kock clips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Asela Gunaratne introduced into the bowling attack.
FOUR BYES! Slips in a googly outside off, spinning in. Amla goes for a drive but misses and it also beats the keeper. Runs down to the fence and four byes signalled by the umpire!
Loopy ball around off, Amla defends it off the back foot to covers.
Tossed up on middle and leg, nudged round the corner for a single.
Drags his length back in the line of the stumps, de Kock looks to pull it hard but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to the off side.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Hashim Amla brings up his 32nd ODI fifty.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the right of short cover and gets a single. It has been a good knock and he needs to carry on.
Drinks have been called.
Slow through the air and fullish on middle, Amla eases it down to long on for a single. Moves to 49 from 48 balls!
Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Amla plays it with an open face to third man and gets two runs for it.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up delivery, de Kock kneels and looks to sweep it uppishly but gets a top edge on it. The ball runs through backward square leg for a boundary.
Fullish ball on the stumps, eased to long on for a single.
Quinton comes down the track to the flighted ball and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This time Quinton nudges it with the spin round the corner for a run and retains the strike.
Slow through the air on leg stump, de Kock looks to clip it across but is rapped on the pads.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Similar length ball outside off, de Kock punches it to deep cover for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, Amla punches it through backward point for a run.
Bowls a short ball on middle, Quinton pulls it with ease to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes into the attack now. Can he strike?
Short ball, de Kock gets on the back foot and punches it through covers for a single.
Amla flicks it towards mid-wicket to run a single.

FOUR! Chance? Oh definitely yes. Floated delivery, outside off, Amla looks to dab it to third man but edges it to Tharanga  at 1st slip. The slip fielder fails to even get finger tips to it, initially going to his right,  he has no to time to adjust and go to his left side from where it rolls away to the third man fence.
Tossed up delivery, de Kock works it around towards the leg side to bring up the 100-run stand between him and Amla. They bump fists to acknowledge the feat.
QDK pushes this back to the bowler.
Amla drives it through mid on region to run a single.
FOUR! Tosses this one, de Kock gets his front foot across and lofts it towards long off for boundary. Expensive over, 13 off it!
Sprays this outside off, de Kock unleashes the reverse sweep, albeit straight to the point fielder.
Amla drives it through mid off to take a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Amla cuts it to deep point to find the fence.
Amla pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery, Amla flicks it with total control, the deep square leg fielder hares across but gets beaten.

In the air........ safe! Floated delivery, around middle and leg, Amla flicks it in the air. However, Mendis at short mid-wicket mistimes his jump and it goes past him. One run added to the total! Kusal seems distraught.
QDK drives it through covers and runs one.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Amla cuts it through point to take a single.
HA knocks it back to the bowler.
Amla drives it towards covers.
De Kock pushes it to long off and runs one.
De Kock works it around to retain strike. Single taken!
10th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock.
FOUR! Tossed up, outside off, de Kock gets ahead and drives it through covers to bring up the milestone in grand fashion. It has been a brilliant knock so far and he looks set for a big one.
Floated delivery, Amla dances down the track and drives it to long off. One run added to the total!
Tosses it up around leg, de Kock flicks it towards deep mid-wicket to take a single.
Floated delivery, outside off, Amla pushes it through covers and runs one.
Tossed up delivery, on middle, Amla knock it back to the bowler.
Sachith Pathirana introduced into the bowling attack.
Sprays this on the pads, de Kock drives it back to the bowler.
Amla flicks it off his pads towards deep mid-wicket and runs one.
Amla knocks it back to the bowler.
Flight on offer, Amla is playing for the turn and is looking to flick, but it takes the outside edge and goes towards the bowler.
Backward square leg, deep mid-wicket and a long on in place now for Amla.
Floated delivery, around off, de Kock pushes it towards the cover region and steals a quick single.
Tossed up delivery, around off, de Kock cuts it towards covers.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA to roll his arm over now.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled by the umpire. 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle now.
On a length, Amla defends it on the up. Outstanding first ten overs for the hosts as they have scored at a run rate of 7.1.
Length ball outside off, QDK plays it towards the leg side and runs one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the southpaw. Good length, de Kock uses his feet and guides it past the point region. The third man runs across, even dives, but it was too good for him.
FOUR! Shot of the day so far! Length ball, outside off, de Kock cuts it past the point fielder and holds his position. He knows it was remarkable and wants to enjoy it.
Length delivery, on leg, Amla works it around and runs one. He wants a two, but his partner isn't ready for it and backs out.
Back of a length delivery, around off, de Kock cuts it towards point to run a single.
SURANGA LAKMAL comes back for a bowl.
Length ball, outside off, de Kock steers it through point and sets off. Amla reciprocates as they complete the single easily.
Fuller delivery, de Kock drives it towards mid on.
3000 ODI runs for Quinton de Kock. He becomes the fastest wicket-keeper to reach this mark in only 74 innings.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, de Kock plays the wristy pull shot towards long leg. This lad is enjoying himself out there.
Length ball, outside off, de Kock cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Good length delivery, around middle, de Kock works it to the leg side.

FOUR! Too straight this from Madushanka. Length ball, on the pads, asking to be punished. Quinton flicks it towards deep  mid-wicket. The deep square leg hared across but it was too far away from his reach.
Good length delivery, outside off, de Kock gets low and cuts it towards third man for a single.
Length ball, around off, de Kock lunges forward and defends as the bat twists in his hand.
FOUR! Short delivery, Quinton pulls it from well within the crease towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Easy pickings for the southpaw.
FOUR! Attempted yorker, but de Kock converts it into a full toss as he pushes it back past the bowler. Both mid off and mid on run across but fail to cut it off.
Short, going down the leg side, Amla hops and pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller delivery, on middle, Amla's dig goes back towards the bowler.
Fuller delivery, around middle and off, Quinton blocks it and looks for a run but Amla refuses.
Length ball, on middle, QDK knocks it to the leg side.
FOUR! Room on offer, de Kock says thank you very much. Short and wide, the southpaw cuts it past the covers and finds the fence.
On a length, outside off, Amla dabs it towards third man and runs one.
Good length delivery, on leg, de Kock flicks it through square leg to bring Amla on strike. One run added to the total!
Length ball, nipping back in, de Kock moves his feet a bit and defends it.
Lahiru Madushanka comes into the attack.
On a length, around off, Amla shows full face of the bat and looks to defend. It is in the air for a very short time, but lands safe ahead of the bowler.
Length ball, going in, Amla flicks it towards square leg.
Short of a length delivery, Amla looks to pull but misses.
Free Hit coming up.

Length ball, outside off, Amla defends it towards covers. Oh hold on, the umpire has called it a no ball. But replays suggest that Kumara's landing was proper. Harsh call this! Free Hit for South Africa!
Amla pushes this length delivery towards covers.
Jeez, there's some bounce in this wicket. Back of a length delivery, it bounces more than the southpaw is expecting but he regains some control and steers it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Kumara, coming from  round the wicket, pitches this one on good length, it was going in, de Kock shuffles a bit and whips it. The mid on fielder could've been a lot better there, the ball slips past him and goes to the mid-wicket fence.

FOUR! Lakmal seems to be under pressure. Short and wide, Amla cuts it towards deep point and finds the fence. There was a third man deployed, but he had no chance whatsoever. Amla's looking in good nick. Two boundaries off the over!
FOUR! WOW! Pure timing. Over pitched delivery, Amla gets forward and slaps it with supreme control past the cover fielder.
Length ball, swinging away, Amla leans forward and is solid in defense.
Full delivery, around off, Amla goes for a wild drive and gets beaten. Poor shot that, he was playing away from his body. Could've been a goner.
Length delivery, Lakmal manages to extract good bounce as Amla gets hit on the gloves.
Length ball, around off, Amla defends it.
Length ball, around off, de Kock pushes it towards covers.
On a length, outside off, de Kock throws his bat at it, the cover fielder stops it.
Length delivery, de Kock gets right on top of it and cuts it hard, but Dhananjaya de Silva makes a fantastic stop at point.
Same length, around leg, de Kock works it around to mid-wicket.
Short of a length delivery, de Kock tucks it around past the square leg and runs a brace.
Back of a length delivery, de Kock looks to pull, but doesn't quiet connect it as it goes to square leg.
Length ball, nipping back in, Amla blocks it towards covers.
Length ball, sixth stump line, Amla shoulders his arms.
FOUR! Good length, around off, Amla hops a tad bit and punches it on the back foot past the diving point fielder. Outstanding stroke this!
Similar delivery, way outside off, Lakmal gives Amla no reason to play at it.
Length ball, outside off, Amla decides to leave it alone.
FOUR! Half volley, Amla gets right under and drives it gloriously through covers to find the fence. Avoid bowling those to Amla, Lakmal!

On a length, outside off, de Kock's punch bisects mid off and the cover fielder, the mid off gives it a chase and tosses the ball to the cover fielder who makes the throw. Two runs added to the total!
Length delivery, outside off, de Kock punches it straight to covers.

Length ball, on middle, it raps de Kock  on the front pad, while he looks to flick, which excites Kumara as he goes for the appeal. But the umpire is not interested just like other Sri Lankan players as the ball pitched outside leg stump.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, de Kock goes for the pull, but it takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg fence. Lucky boundary, this!
Length ball, de Kock hops and blocks it. It seemed like it was going towards the stumps, but the southpaw was aware.
Length ball, on middle, de Kock defends it right under his eye line.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl from the other end.
Good length delivery, around off, Amla drives to covers.
On a length, way outside off, Amla offers no shot.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, going down the leg side, Amla tickles it fine to score the first boundary of the innings. Poor delivery and Amla doesn't leave those.
Marginally ahead of length, on middle, Amla knocks it back to the bowler.
Length delivery, around off, de Kock cuts it to third man and runs one.
Length ball, outside off, de Kock has a look and leaves it alone.
The players and the umpires make their way out in the middle. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla will open the batting for the Proteas. Suranga Lakmal to start off with the new ball. Here we go...

SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD. Two changes for the hosts, ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO and CHRIS MORRIS come in while Dwaine Pretorius and Tabraiz Shamsi go out. For the visitors, Nuwan Kulasekara and Lakshan Sandakan make way for SURANGA LAKMAL and JEFFREY VANDERSAY.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the fifth and the final match of this series. A tour Sri Lanka will leave with not too many fond memories. Yes, they did win the T20I series, but it was against a second string South African side. The last match saw a great contest as Faf du Plessis from the home camp, and Upul Tharanga from the other, scored brilliant centuries. But in the end, South Africa had the last laugh. Coming to Centurion, the weather is cloudy and it could rain during some part of the match. The hosts wouldn't want any disruption as they have an opportunity to go on top of the ICC ODI rankings. Can we expect them to do that or will Sri Lanka end the tour on a good note?
